Depths_3F_Text_Boss_After.en: The cave is quiet now. For today.
Depths_3F_Text_Boss_After.fr: La grotte est calme maintenant.\nPour aujourd'hui.

Depths_3F_Text_Boss_Defeat.en: So there was a floor after all.
Depths_3F_Text_Boss_Defeat.fr: Il y avait donc un sol, après tout.

Depths_3F_Text_Boss_Intro.en: The bottom? There is no bottom.\nThere is only me, wherever you\pstop.
Depths_3F_Text_Boss_Intro.fr: Le fond ? Il n'y a pas de fond. Il\nn'y a que moi, où que tu t'arrêtes.

Depths_3F_Text_Boss_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
Depths_3F_Text_Boss_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

Depths_3F_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

Depths_3F_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
